seo.description: Visit the Skala du Port in Essaouira: fortified harbour walls, views over blue fishing boats and the Îles Purpuraires offshore.
seo.keywords: Skala du Port, Essaouira harbour, port ramparts, Îles Purpuraires view

name: Skala du Port
hero_subtitle: Harbour ramparts with views over the fishing fleet and the rocky islands offshore.

overview.title: Walls above the boats
overview.p1: The Skala du Port runs along the fortified edge of Essaouira’s working harbour. From the platform you look down on blue boats, nets and the channel out toward the Îles Purpuraires.
overview.p2: It is shorter and more intimate than the Skala de la Ville, with a stronger sense of daily port life. Morning is best when the fleet is active.
overview.p3: Combine it with a walk through the fish stalls and a simple grilled-fish lunch.

food.title: Food near Skala du Port

food.li1: Grilled fish stalls by the quay.
food.li2: Simple seafood plates near the port gate.
food.li3: Medina restaurants a short walk inland.
food.li5: Watch your step on wet quay stones.
food.p2: Ask prices before ordering at informal stands.

q2.question: Different from Skala de la Ville?
q2.answer: Yes — closer to the fleet, with island views; the Ville Skala is the big cannon platform.

q4.question: Safe with kids?
q4.answer: Yes on the walkways; hold hands near edges.

q5.question: Boat trips to the islands?
q5.answer: Sometimes offered when sea conditions allow — ask at the port, never insist in rough weather.
